title: Juicer
statementMd:
Kolya is going to make fresh orange juice. He has $*n*$ oranges of sizes $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. Kolya will put them in the juicer in the fixed order, starting with orange of size $*a*_{1}$, then orange of size $*a*_{2}$ and so on. To be put in the juicer the orange must have size not exceeding $*b*$, so if Kolya sees an orange that is strictly greater he throws it away and continues with the next one.

The juicer has a special section to collect waste. It overflows if Kolya squeezes oranges of the total size strictly greater than $*d*$. When it happens Kolya empties the waste section (even if there are no more oranges) and continues to squeeze the juice. How many times will he have to empty the waste section?

## Input

The first line of the input contains three integers $*n*$, $*b*$ and $*d*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$, $1 ≤ *b* ≤ *d* ≤ 1 000 000$) — the number of oranges, the maximum size of the orange that fits in the juicer and the value $*d*$, which determines the condition when the waste section should be emptied.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1 000 000$) — sizes of the oranges listed in the order Kolya is going to try to put them in the juicer.

## Output

Print one integer — the number of times Kolya will have to empty the waste section.

## Note

In the first sample, Kolya will squeeze the juice from two oranges and empty the waste section afterwards.

In the second sample, the orange won't fit in the juicer so Kolya will have no juice at all.
statementZhMd:
Kolya 准备制作新鲜的橙汁。他有 $*n*$ 个橙子，大小分别为 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。Kolya 会按照固定顺序将它们放入榨汁机中：先放入大小为 $*a*_{1}$ 的橙子，然后是大小为 $*a*_{2}$ 的橙子，依此类推。要放入榨汁机，橙子的大小不能超过 $*b*$，因此如果 Kolya 看到一个严格大于该大小的橙子，他就会将其丢弃，并继续处理下一个橙子。

榨汁机有一个专门收集废料的部分。如果 Kolya 榨取的橙子总大小严格大于 $*d*$，该部分就会溢出。发生这种情况时，Kolya 会清空废料收集部分（即使已经没有更多橙子），然后继续榨汁。他需要清空废料收集部分多少次？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*b*$ 和 $*d*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *b* ≤ *d* ≤ 1 000 000$）——橙子的数量、能够放入榨汁机的橙子的最大大小，以及决定何时清空废料收集部分的数值 $*d*$。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1 000 000$）——按照 Kolya 尝试将它们放入榨汁机的顺序给出的橙子大小。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Kolya 需要清空废料收集部分的次数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Kolya 会榨取两个橙子的汁液，然后清空废料收集部分。

在第二个样例中，橙子无法放入榨汁机，因此 Kolya 完全没有榨取到果汁。
